identifier.value: RightNow AI CUDA Kernel Generation and Optimization Platform

product.name: RightNow AI CUDA Kernel Generation and Optimization Platform
product.description: A platform that automatically profiles, detects bottlenecks, and optimizes CUDA kernels to improve GPU performance across major NVIDIA architectures.

product.name: Serverless GPU Profiling Service
product.description: A cloud-based service that profiles CUDA kernels on serverless GPUs to identify performance bottlenecks without requiring local GPU hardware.

product.name: Natural Language CUDA Kernel Generation
product.description: A feature that allows users to generate high-performance CUDA kernels using simple natural language prompts without requiring deep CUDA expertise.

product.name: Inference-Time Scaling and Performance Benchmarking
product.description: Tools integrated into the platform to measure and scale CUDA kernel performance during inference and benchmark GPU code efficiency.
